prompt: Build one list of the prices set or seen for product 3 in 2025: each list price version in price_history whose valid_from is from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, and each competitor price check in competitor_prices made in 2025. observed_ts holds the time of the check in UTC, so take 2025 in UTC: from 2025-01-01 00:00 up to but not including 2026-01-01 00:00. Return two columns, in this order: source, the text 'Voltmarkt' for a list price version or the competitor's name for a check, and price_eur. Return one row for each list price version and one for each check, so a repeated price appears every time. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, stack the 2025 price checks under the 2025 list price versions, with the same two columns in the same order.
UNION ALL keeps every row, repeats included. valid_from is a date and observed_ts a time, so the end of 2025 needs a different test in each part.
why_this_works: UNION ALL keeps every 2025 list price version and check, and the half-open range on observed_ts keeps the checks of 31 December.
